  summary_zh: src.summary_zh ?? null,

  official_source_candidates: src.official_source_candidates ?? [],
  official_source_url: src.official_source_url ?? null,
  official_source_title: src.official_source_title ?? null,
  official_image_url: src.official_image_url ?? null,
  asset_source: src.asset_source ?? null,
  rights_status: src.rights_status ?? null
};

const draft = $json;
const normalizeConfidence = (value) => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
  let n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return null;
  if (n > 1 && n <= 100) n = n / 100;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(n.toFixed(3))));
};
const sourceItems = $('解析商业分析JSON').all();
const draftContentId = draft.content_id || draft.video_id || null;
const base = sourceItems.find(item => item.json?.content_id === draftContentId)?.json || sourceItems[$itemIndex]?.json || {};
const qc = draft.quality_control || {};
const commercial = draft.commercial_editorial_note || {};
const facts = draft.fact_boundary || {};
const hasValue = (value) => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '' && !(Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0) && !(typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && Object.keys(value).length === 0);
const firstValid = (...values) => values.find(hasValue);
const assetFields = {};
for (const key of ['content_visual_binding_key','image_title_overlay_language','image_title_overlay_status','asset_kind','asset_selection_reason','asset_subject','asset_match_status','official_image_url','official_source_url']) {
  const value = firstValid(draft[key], base[key]);
  if (hasValue(value)) assetFields[key] = value;
}
return { json: {
  content_id: draft.content_id || base.content_id,
  platform: base.platform || 'YouTube',
  source: base.source || 'YouTube Data API',
  source_url: draft.source_url || base.source_url || null,
  video_id: base.video_id || null,
  title: base.title || draft.chinese?.title || draft.english?.title || 'Untitled',
  description: base.description || null,
  author: base.author || null,
  channel_id: base.channel_id || null,
  published_at: base.published_at || null,
  thumbnail: base.thumbnail || null,
  language: base.language || null,
  content_type: base.content_type || 'video',
  robotics_topic: base.robotics_topic || 'robotics',
  view_count: base.view_count ?? 0,
  like_count: base.like_count ?? 0,
  comment_count: base.comment_count ?? 0,
  favorite_count: base.favorite_count ?? 0,
  engagement: base.engagement || {},
  viral_score: base.viral_score ?? null,
  score_source: base.score_source || 'DeepSeek',
  ai_summary: draft.editorial_angle || base.ai_summary || null,
  status: draft.generation_status || 'draft_generated',
  is_robotics: base.business_analysis?.is_robotics ?? null,
  category: base.business_analysis?.category ?? base.category ?? null,
  summary_zh: draft.chinese?.body || draft.summary_zh || draft.business_analysis?.summary_zh || null,
  summary_en: draft.english?.body || draft.summary_en || draft.business_analysis?.summary_en || null,
  chinese: draft.chinese || {},
  english: draft.english || {},
  image_plan: draft.image_plan || {},
  platform_adaptations: draft.platform_adaptations || {},
  fact_boundary: draft.fact_boundary || {},
  quality_control: draft.quality_control || {},
  key_facts: facts.confirmed_facts || [],
  why_it_may_work: commercial.why_now || base.business_analysis?.why_it_may_work || base.why_it_may_work || null,
  hook: draft.chinese?.hook || draft.english?.hook || null,
  target_audience: commercial.who_should_care || [],
  analyzed_content_type: 'bilingual_image_text',
  analyzed_language: 'zh-en',
  recommended_route: 'bilingual_image_text',
  priority: base.business_analysis?.priority ?? base.priority ?? null,
  keep: base.business_analysis?.keep ?? base.keep ?? null,
  confidence: normalizeConfidence(base.business_analysis?.confidence ?? base.analysis_confidence),
  analysis_confidence: normalizeConfidence(base.business_analysis?.confidence ?? base.analysis_confidence),
  commercial_value: base.business_analysis?.commercial_value ?? base.commercial_value ?? {},
  risk_flags: qc.risk_flags || base.risk_flags || [],
  uncertainty: facts.unknowns || base.uncertainty || [],
  analysis_status: 'bilingual_draft_generated',
  final_route: 'bilingual_image_text',
  next_module: qc.ready_for_human_review === true ? 'human_review' : 'fact_check',
  official_source_url: assetFields.official_source_url ?? null,
  official_source_title: draft.official_source_title || base.official_source_title || null,
  official_image_url: assetFields.official_image_url ?? null,
  asset_source: draft.asset_source || base.asset_source || null,
  rights_status: draft.rights_status || base.rights_status || 'official_source_not_confirmed',
  image_asset_status: draft.official_image_url ? 'candidate_found_review_required' : 'not_found',
  approval_status: 'pending_approval',
  x_publish_status: 'pending_approval',
  ...assetFields,
  raw_search_item: base.raw_search_item || {},
  raw_statistics_item: base.raw_statistics_item || {},
  raw_deepseek_item: { score: base.raw_deepseek_item || {}, business_analysis: base.business_analysis || {}, bilingual_draft: draft },
  collected_at: base.collected_at || new Date().toISOString(),
  analyzed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  route_decision_at: new Date().toISOString()
} };

const items = $input.all().map(i => i.json || {});
return items.sort((a,b) => Number(b.viral_score || 0) - Number(a.viral_score || 0)).map((json,index) => ({json:{...json, screening_rank:index+1, screening_status:'selected_for_analysis', recommended_route:'commercial_analysis'}}));
